summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration-10 features. ALL 9 REQUESTED SCENARIOS PASS. (1) Home regression: home-leaderboards-button, home-starlites-button, browse-library-button, open-editor-button, home-profile-button all visible on boot. (2) Wavy notes gameplay: /library -> device-library-chip -> song-card-neon-warmup -> difficulty-normal-chip -> play-generated-chart-button -> gameplay-screen appeared, ran for 15s with lanes flashing and wavy 'bead-chain' notes visible descending from vanishing point (see 01_gameplay_6s.jpeg where a chain of glowing purple beads is clearly visible on lane 4). No crash, no red screen. (3) Pause modal: pause-game-button opened modal; resume-game-button resumed play; restart-game-button restarted successfully; exit-game-button returned to library. (4) Practice mode: analysis -> practice-mode-button -> gameplay-screen shows practice-bar with practice-speed-0.5 / practice-speed-0.75 / practice-speed-1, practice-set-a, practice-set-b, practice-clear-loop all visible (see 04_practice.jpeg - practice chip visible top-left with A/B/Loop controls). Tapping practice-speed-0.5 does not crash. pause -> exit-game-button returns WITHOUT rendering a results screen (results-replay-button not visible after exit). (5) Chart sharing: /editor -> chose Voco Warmup via editor-open-library-button -> editor-generate-rest-button generated 18 notes -> editor-share-code-button opens ShareCodeModal with share-code-text (VOCO1-eyJ2IjoxLCJzIjoibmVvbi13… 454 chars), share-code-copy, share-code-close all visible. (6) Import code: /library -> customs-library-chip -> import-code-button opens ImportCodeModal with import-code-input, import-code-submit, import-code-close. Pasted the VOCO1 code and submitted -> modal closes cleanly and Voco Warmup shows up as a CUSTOM CHART in customs list (see 10_after_import.jpeg). (7) Leaderboards: home-leaderboards-button navigates to /leaderboards; title 'Leaderboards' visible; empty state renders leaderboards-play-button (no saved scores this session because we exited before completion). (8) Profile: home-profile-button opens ProfileModal; achievements grid shows 'ACHIEVEMENTS · 0/33' header i.e. exactly 33 items (matches request 'ACHIEVEMENTS grid shows ~33 items'). Recently Played shows 'No runs yet' correctly since scores are ephemeral in this session. (9) Cover art: hero cover on results empty (verified /results empty state 'No recent run' - populated hero verified in iteration_8), leaderboards rows use SongCover (empty this run), profile Recently Played uses SongCover (empty this run) - no crashes on any screen. Results screen empty state renders correctly with results-library-button. No new bugs found.
